_about: Structural rules every IRBlock must satisfy. Validated by intent/validate.py BEFORE render — failures fire as `error` severity so the architect-retry loop catches them. Every threshold here is config-driven so a project can loosen / tighten without code changes. Adding a new constraint = one JSON key + one validator branch.
_connector_refdes_doc: Refdes letters used for connectors (jacks, headers, sockets, plugs). Per ASME Y14.44 / IEEE 315 the canonical letter is 'J' (jack); some projects use 'P' (plug) for cable-side or 'CN' for sub-classified connectors. Consumed by the single_connector_blocks exemption --- a block on the single_connector_blocks list with exactly ONE component whose refdes letter is in this list AND with pin count >= minimum_anchor_pin_count is exempt from BLOCK_TOO_SMALL. Add new refdes letters here when a project uses an unusual convention; no Python edit required.
_anchor_refdes_doc: Refdes letters whose components are considered structural anchors of a block (per ASME Y14.44 / IEEE 315). A block must contain at least one component whose refdes letter is in this list AND whose pin count is >= minimum_anchor_pin_count. Single-pin parts (test points, mounting holes) do not count. Tune for a project that uses unusual refdes letters.
_passives_only_blocks_doc: Block names that are legitimately ALLOWED to contain only passives / 2-pin parts (R / C / L / D / crystal) without a multi-pin (>= minimum_anchor_pin_count) IC anchor. Examples: INDICATOR (LED + series R), CLOCK (Y1 crystal + 2 load caps --- crystals are 2-pin by definition so they fail the >=3 pin anchor rule even though they ARE the anchor of a CLOCK block), RESET (R pullup + switch + decoupling cap). Adding a name here exempts it from BLOCK_NO_ANCHOR. To restore strict anchor enforcement for any block, remove its name from this list. The size check (BLOCK_TOO_SMALL) still applies --- block must have >= minimum_components_per_block parts.
_single_connector_blocks_doc: Block names that are legitimately ALLOWED to contain only ONE component when that component is a multi-pin connector (refdes prefix J). SWD/ICSP/JTAG programming headers are 6-pin connectors that constitute a self-contained functional block on their own --- without this exemption, a board with just one SWD header forces the architect to dump it into a neighbouring block (CLOCK / MCU / etc.), visually splitting unrelated sections. Bypass: a block whose name is in this list AND whose component_refs[] contains exactly one J* component with >= minimum_anchor_pin_count pins is exempt from BLOCK_TOO_SMALL.
_minimum_anchor_pin_count_doc: Smallest pin count for an anchor component. 3 = SOT-23 transistor / 3-pin LDO / 3-pin connector. Raise to 4-6 for boards whose 'anchor' should always be a chip, lower to 2 for very loose hierarchies.
_minimum_components_per_block_doc: Smallest block that's worth a child sheet. Single-component blocks (e.g. INDICATOR containing only D1) are noise; merge them into siblings. Set to 1 to allow them.
_single_component_blocks_allowed_doc: Quick override of minimum_components_per_block. When true, any block with >= 1 component passes BLOCK_TOO_SMALL. When false (default), the minimum applies.
_gates_doc: Per-check toggles. Set any to false to disable that validator branch without code changes (e.g. tutorial circuits where INDICATOR-only blocks are pedagogical).
